claims.object_text: target of kudzu root components related to excitatory amino acids and calcium overload
claims.quote: The targets covered were proteins related to excitatory amino acids and calcium overload, including Excitatory amino acid transporter 2 (SLC1A2), Glutamate receptor ionotropic, kainate 1 (GRIK1), Glutamate receptor ionotropic, NMDA 1 (GRIN1)
